notes.title: February Update Rollback to v1.9
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Lisy here, producer at LoG. The highest pillar of our production process here at LoG is stability. Build stability takes precedence and priority over every single decision we make at LoG. 

And, yep! You’re not imagining things, the February update of Armello’s Road to 2.0 is *very* unstable. 

We came in to see this this morning…

https://i.imgur.com/Fgu9FLt.jpg

And then, upon further investigation, this... 

https://i.imgur.com/oMR8hcY.jpg

Since releasing the February update we’ve seen a sharp increase of NMA’s (instances when the game does not crash, but “No More Actions” are possible) and Crashes affecting around 16% of games played. This is something we’re taking very seriously and obviously the entire team is truly devastated about it.

With stability being LoG’s highest pillar, we have decided to temporarily roll back Armello to v1.9.2. 

What you need to know (The TL:DR): 

We have rolled the February update back to v1.9.2 ‘From Below’.
We’ll be working to re-release the February update over the upcoming week. We’ve shifted Karl (lead developer) and Tom (tech director) onto this and only this and QA internal resources will be tripled until the update is out again.
A community testing round will be held when the build is ready.
The Lunar Dice event is currently suspended, but will return within the next 3 days. 
As a result of this, Lunar Dice assets have been removed from the game. They will remain in your inventories and return as soon as the event is live again. 
Upon its return, we will extend the Lunar Dice event to account for any down time (and then some!). 
As a gesture of goodwill, we will also activate double drops for the entirety of the Lunar Dice Event. 

Why did all this happen? 
Okay, so strangely, here’s where the good news is... the February update had some very extensive AI changes hidden in the build. Major AI improvements were to be one of our 2.0 key features that we would announced later this year. Surprise! :/

We’ve been working on the AI overhaul for a while now and the February update was the first build that had these changes merged in.

While these features are not publicly visible or ready to be made “active” in the build, the code was still affected by changes made to support these new features, and apparently waiting to wreak havoc on the live build.  

As part of our release process we have full analytics on test builds, three in-house QA folks manually testing the build, automated testing seeking out errors, crashes and NMAs (by playing four multiplayer games at 10x speed all day and night, non-stop!) before builds are approved for release. We intermittently run community testing, and yes, in hindsight it may have proven valuable for this release. However, time and resources leading up to the release of the February update did not permit us to coordinate this option. 

Additionally, the particular crashes and NMAs occurring in the February update slipped through all above QA measures and realistically, the brute force “testing” provided when the game is live (approx. 10,000 games played per day) is the only thing that would have alerted us to these issues. 

What are we doing to prevent this in future releases: 

Conduct a post-mortem of our QA and production processes to understand what learnings there are for future releases. 
Analysing each NMA/crash and refining our manual and automated test cases to be able to identify these particular bugs. 
Redesigning our community testing methods to enable a greater diversity of machines, players and network environments, so that we can employ community testing rounds for every release with maximum efficiency and effectiveness.
Armello will never be updated again. (lol, jk. It’s gonna be updated a LOT.) 

Unfortunately, we cannot promise that we will completely eliminate any chance of this happening again. Gamedev is chaotic and Armello is a hyper complex game. BUT what we can promise is that we’ll always respond to these situations as fast as possible, with your best interests in mind, to get you back into Armello with minimal delay.

Thank you all for sending through your bug reports and forum posts, they truly are invaluable and we really appreciate everyone’s patience during this release. We’ll get the February update and Lunar Dice event back online ASAP. Hopefully this transparency into our processes can give you a little insight into our efforts in making this happen. 

If you do have any concerns or questions, feel free to reach out to admin[at]leagueofgeeks.com! We will be posting more information as soon as we’re able to! 

Happy gaming folks! See you in the February update (again, soon!)

<3

Lisy and the LoG Team

notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif

Happy New Year friends!

Hope you're all well and I hope your batteries are all recharged for a cool new year. We just pushed an update that tends to one important bug that popped up whilst we were away.

Bug Fixes
Removed bugged player account from the Multiplayer queue.


This is a really weird one so I'm going to elaborate for those that are interested. A user's Steam account bugged out, leaving essentially a ghost in our multiplayer queue. We couldn't remove them from the queue, because they aren't even in Armello, it's just some series of network messages caught in a loop.

By updating Armello's version, we've essentially left that queue-ghost on a now reduntant version, where it will actually continue to exist indefinitely, as far as we can tell.

This is some bizarre, Black Mirror stuff.


Cheers,

<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad

We couldn't remove them from the queue, because they aren't even in Armello, it's just some series of network messages caught in a loop.

By updating Armello's version, we've essentially left that queue-ghost on a now reduntant version, where it will actually continue to exist indefinitely, as far as we can tell.

This is some bizarre, Black Mirror stuff.


Cheers,

<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad

notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif

Hey folks,

Here are the patch notes for v1.9.3 and along with it, the Rivals Beta event is live until 13th of December, 3:00pm (PT). We'll do a seperate announcement about the beta event in just a moment so head there for all of the details for that.

Please be mindful that with larger changes, like new heroes for example, comes a certain amount of chaos. Be sure to submit bug reports if you encounter any weirdness, and please share your feedback about the new bits and pieces!

New Heroes (Live December 20th)
The four new heroes will be playable by anyone that owns Armello on Steam during the Rivals Beta event, starting now and finishing on the 13th of December, 3:00pm (Pacific Time).
Fang (Wolf Clan) Hero Power: When attacking, if Fang Slaughters his opponent, Battle ends before they strike back.
Hargrave (Rabbit Clan) Hero Power: After ending his turn on a Plains, Hargrave will fire his cannon at any creature entering an adjacent tile.
Yordana (Bear Clan) Hero Power: Spells cast to Yordana during her turn are devoured in her cauldron for -1 Magic, granting a Curse Spell at the end of her turn.
Griotte (Rat Clan) Hero Power: Griotte's Clan Affinity Dice Bonus is equal to the number of Trickery Cards played the previous Day.

New Ring & Amulets (Live December 20th)
Intimidate (Amulet): End your turn next to a creature, they suffer -1 Dice until the end of their next turn.
Cat's Eye (Rat Ring): Get a 1 Gold refund on First Trickery Card played each Turn.
Spinel (Rabbit Ring): Get a 10% bonus in all Quest Tests.
Chrysocolla (Wolf Ring): Grants scout on heroes with 2 Health or less
Taaffeite (Bear Ring): +1 Shield in Forests.

Card changes
Bane Blade (Treasure): Effect is now "In Battle, +4 Dice. After each Battle where you don't kill your opponent, -1 Health."
Blood Money (Trickery): Increased frequency in deck. 
Expendables (Trickery): Increased frequency in deck.
Incite Revolt (Trickery): Increased frequency in deck. 
Arson (Trickery): Cost decreased from 3 Prestige to 2.
Ranger's Cloak (Item): Cost decreased from 2 to 1.

Bug Fixes
Fixed rare bug where the End Turn button would remain on screen (multiplayer only).
Fixed bug where you couldn't customise AI dice skins in singleplayer. 
Fixed bug where Fast Forward animation would not appear on icon when using the direct right thumbstick push on controllers. 
Continue button would overlap prologue chat when a controller is plugged in. 
Fixed bug where turn timer layered over the hero portrait. 
Fixed bug where previewing Quest rewards with controller would cause overlapping.

Known Issues
Amber & Sana's Prologue will NMA if you enter battle with AI. 
Cat's Eye doesn't correctly take Gold.
Griotte will revert to fanning animation in Clan Grounds if she dies at night with her Hero Power active.
Hargrave hunkers down when his turn is forced to end.
AFK timer may not kick AFK players correctly.
Multiplayer banners may not appear in lobbies correctly.
EDIT: Curse of Eye Yordana pact does not visually break correctly on combat. (gameplay effect ends, but pact visuals remain until either player dies)


THERE YOU HAVE IT FOLKS! Have fun, do some good battle and good luck in your journey for the throne.


Cheers,

<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad

notes.title: Hotfix v1.9.1 (patch 6), & Dev Insights
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/3C5hDOd.gif

Hey all,

Here's another patch straight from the patch farm. It has grown in to a strong beast and now is ready for the public. Just below, we're going to address recent confusion/concerns about patch size and content relevant to other platforms sneaking in to the build.

Bug Fixes
Rings and Amulets now available to play in Offline mode
Ring and Amulet progression are now working in Offline mode
Fixed transmogrify is now work for Collection 1
Fixed rare UI glitch of Skeeve's store showing incorrect

Known Issues
Rare NMA on AFK player only when trying to disconnect from game.

Patch Size
We're aware that these smaller hotfixes are coming through as larger downloads. I believe this one was over 700mb and we totally understand that this is not ideal. We're going to keep an eye on the size and frequency of those bad boys to ensure Armello remains accessible to folks all around the world in all different internet conditions. Thank you for your patience on this front.

Other platform content got up in the build(soft currency)
Armello is a complex beast that's on multiple platforms and Unity is our engine of choice. All of our features and code are tossed into one master build and when we make a build ready to go live we chose the platform we're publishing to and Unity SHOULD package it up with the platform specific features only available. Sometimes platform specific stuff slips through like Xbox One controller icons and more recently, iOS specific soft currency UI. 

For those don't know iOS is currently in soft-launch in Australia and New Zealand only while we test out the pricing models as well as stabilising the build. The mobile market is completely different to Steam and we're approaching them with that consideration in mind.

There have been a bunch of conversations online lately about monetisation and lootboxes, and due to this I think folks were concerned to see references to in-game currency in Armello, which is strictly an iOS feature. I want to be clear in saying we don't have plans to integrate this into Armello.

For the sake of transparency, I want to take this opportunity to invite any curious minds out there to check out the iOS beta and judge it on it's own merits. Click the link below to sign up and it'd be much appreciated if you took your time to share your thoughts! The gist of the first review we got was "the drops are so generous, LoG probably won't make any money" which is nice... I think?

http://www.armello.com/iosbeta


Cheers,

<3 Darcy & the LoG Squad

notes.title: Update v1.8.1
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/YcnPGiO.gif

Welcome!

We've got an update for you today that has some features and some fixes to bathe in! Here are the juicy details.

King Voice
The King has brand new end game voice over relevant to victory type (Combat, Prestige, Rot and Spirit Stones)
Combat Audio
New and revised combat audio including blocks, hits, special dice and more.

Simplified Chinese Localisation Rework
We've taken your feedback and completely overhauled the Simple Chinese translation. Let us know what you think!

Fury Mode Tweaks
Thanks to all those who have provided feedback on Fury Mode! We've listened and done a big pass that make it feel a little better overall. Please don't hesitate to hit us up if you have further thoughts/comments.
Fury Mode is now listed as it’s own option in House Rules and will override selected Turn timer options
Card select time is 1 second longer
Moving bonus time has been increased from +2 seconds to +3 seconds
Card select time bonus has been increased by +1 second per card (4 seconds per card now)
When a player's turn timer is paused(such as when they are in a quest) it will appear as grey
Timers are paused for an additional second when a player is exiting Battles and Perils.
Equipping items and followers is a now a smoother and quicker process
Equipping over previously equipped items is now smoother and faster.

Bug Fixes
End turn button is now working correctly for those players with touch screens
Players who have “{ }” in their Steam names will no longer experience difficulty getting into Multiplayer games.



Cheers,

<3 Darcy @ the LoG Squad

EDIT: We're aware of a Ring/Amulet progression bug and we're working hard on a fix,
 more details here.

EDIT 2: This issue has been resolved. <3

A huge fix just went live for a number of visual issues that popped up in v1.8. Check out the full list of things here!

King roars a little too loud.

notes.title: Release v1.5.1!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7614223/01071aebe20643ddd2ebab4dbda875f0dabe55fe.png

Greetings, Armellians!

Due to unforeseen difficulties with new Steam Inventory infrastructure, Armello's third Dice Collection, Traitor's Gift has been delayed. We're working as hard as we can to resolve this and get the new Collection out to you as a priority. Stay tuned for more info on that front.

The good news, however, is that we're getting a rad little update into your hands without the collection. This update brings a bunch of great stuff that we're sure you'll like.

Features

Ghor Hero Power change:  In Forests, Spells cost 1 Magic less for each adjacent Forest and Ghor can cast to any Forest. Ghor does not gain Stealth in Forests at Night. 
Ghor Hero Power visualisation change: Only the Ghor player sees the Forest glowing particles. 
River Hero Power change:  It’s been a long time coming to bring River’s Hero Power in line with how it’s managed. River’s hero power is now correctly treated like an attack in all cases.
- Now triggers Prestige loss vs. King.
- Now triggers a Traitor level Bounty vs. King.
- Now triggers a Wanted level Bounty vs. King's Guard.
- Now removes 3 Prestige during Peace Treaty vs. Hero.
- Now breaks Armistice Pact and become Wanted vs. Pact Hero.
The King’s Voice Over (VO) has received some mastering and polishing.
Due to popular demand, the King now roars again..
Bounty communications now have unique audio SFX. 
Commendation screen now has unique audio SFX.
On completing a public multiplayer game, all human players will receive a Contender Star.
When using a controller, dice are now thrown in the correct direction.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a rare NMA cause by dying on your turn with an active Pact. 
Lone Wolf has been removed from Private games.
Fixed a bug where Tool Tips for Dice show a string. If you see this again, please let us know!
Controllers will now be able to interact with Steam Profiles on the Commendation page. 
Fixed Cards animation in inventories/hands/card gallery. 
Fixed King's Declaration layering over the player's hero shelf. 
Fixed Missing particle on Signet/Ring unlock progression. 
Fixed a visual bug where a player who has left a game via the 'game ready' pop up may have their name appear in the lobby for the next game.
Fixed a rare issue where the trailers in the prologue menu may copy one another, and play the same trailer regardless of which one is clicked. 
Fixed a bug where the in-game pause menu may become unresponsive when attempting to quit a Prologue or Multiplayer game.

Many of these changes have been implemented due to public request, so thank you to all those who went out of their way to provide constructive feedback.


Cheers,

<3 Darcy & the LoG Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.3 [Steam PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 1)
notes.notes:
HEY ARMELLO FAMILY!

An extra hot, hotfix is here, straight out of the codery oven. Thanks to everyone for submitting their detailed logs and emails, you’re all beautiful butterflies. Here’s the latest fixes that have made it into Armello! 

If you’re an individual that is experiencing any Disconnects in multiplayer games we’d like you (the person who disconnected) to submit your logs (even if you don’t think you’ve experienced a bug), as we are investigating some bugs that we are unable to reproduce in the studio. 

Also thanks to Steam user: Anko we’ve been notified that anti-virus programs including and similar to AVG are causing conflicts with Armello. If you are experiencing any crashes or performance issues, we recommend checking that your Anti-Virus programs have Armello as an exception OR try disabling them all together for the interim. 

Features
We’ve expanded the Regions in which a game will search for on our Steam multiplayer platform.

Bug Fixes
Continuing Singleplayer saved games should now work as intended. 
Fixed issues where certain buttons weren’t displaying when using Family Share.
Fixed a rare NMA caused when a player steals another player's Card. 
Fixed a rare NMA caused by a player opening their Rumour Panel while the King is playing Perils during the night phase.
Fixed a rare NMA happening right after the King’s death but before the Victory/Defeat screen.
Fixed a bug where the “Next” button wouldn’t appear in Offline Singleplayer games. 
Fixed a bug when going to the Inventory Screen does not appear and causes an NMA.


Thanks again for all of your reports. Remember, see something, say something.


Cheers,

<3 Darcy

If you’re an individual that is experiencing any Disconnects in multiplayer games we’d like you (the person who disconnected) to submit your logs (even if you don’t think you’ve experienced a bug), as we are investigating some bugs that we are unable to reproduce in the studio. 

Also thanks to Steam user: Anko we’ve been notified that anti-virus programs including and similar to AVG are causing conflicts with Armello. If you are experiencing any crashes or performance issues, we recommend checking that your Anti-Virus programs have Armello as an exception OR try disabling them all together for the interim. 

Features
We’ve expanded the Regions in which a game will search for on our Steam multiplayer platform.

Bug Fixes
Continuing Singleplayer saved games should now work as intended. 
Fixed issues where certain buttons weren’t displaying when using Family Share.
Fixed a rare NMA caused when a player steals another player's Card. 
Fixed a rare NMA caused by a player opening their Rumour Panel while the King is playing Perils during the night phase.
Fixed a rare NMA happening right after the King’s death but before the Victory/Defeat screen.
Fixed a bug where the “Next” button wouldn’t appear in Offline Singleplayer games. 
Fixed a bug when going to the Inventory Screen does not appear and causes an NMA.


Thanks again for all of your reports. Remember, see something, say something.


Cheers,

notes.title: Release v1.2.1
notes.notes:
https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/379/248/51ace5a55c661fbd1c406bda23149b16_original.png?v=1455751446&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9bad85209a170e2362c89af91a5562a7

Hey Armello Fam!

Here's a brand new release to add even more juiciness to the v1.2 The Stranger release, enjoy!

Features:

A range of new visualisations have been implemented to support The Stranger's peculiar behaviour including:

New particles to indicate when the Stranger swaps and when the Stranger moves a Hero.
The overhead icon now appears when a Hero is moved from the Stranger.
New text and communication from the Stranger to add flavour.
The Stranger's combat transfer mechanic has been replaced with a non-combat transfer system. Now, any hero that ends their turn with or adjacent to The Stranger, will trigger a potential host swap.
You can now choose to dismiss the Stranger in House Rules.


Bug Fixes:

The Stranger now force equips when stolen with Bribery.
Fixed a card layering issue that could occur on the decks during the draw phase.
The Stranger will now correctly appear in the Card Gallery when it is equipped!


Need More Info:
We have improved the logging surrounding these particularly rare occurrences. Please let us know if you encounter any of the following issues.

On rare occasions, card draw fails and breaks the flow of gameplay, resulting in an NMA (No More Action state).
On launch, the player may be confronted with a white screen, blocking progress into the game and causing an NMA.
Multiplayer combat NMA. If encountered, it's important that we receive logs from all players in that game.
A tile may appear blocked, restricting movement for seemingly no reason.


As always, if you see something, say something. If you encounter any buggy weirdness, please let us know over here OR submit an in-game Bug report.


THANKS ALL!

<3 Darcy

notes.title: Hotfix v1.2 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 2)
notes.notes:
Hey Armellians,

The hottest of fixes is fresh from the oven ready for you to jump on in. We’ve fixed some minor bugs as well as a few NMA’s (No More Action’s), here are the full details:

Bug Fixes

Fixed an NMA caused by the Bane Blade card effect.
Fixed an NMA if you play two cards on a human player Hero in quick succession the target no longer NMA.
The Stranger will no longer move you before your Card Draw which fixes a myriad of issues.
Fixed an NMA where a player with The Stranger equipped would enter the Palace AND there was at least one player using non-English text.
Saved Games across updates will now correctly be deleted resulting in Singleplayer games working as intended.
Fixed a bug where if you start your turn on a Quest The Stranger will move you but you will still encounter the Quest. 

These NMA’s would also have given the player the impression that Turn Timers and the AFK feature was not functioning. 

Known Issues

There are still edge case NMA’s where The Stranger attempts to swap from Combat, we haven’t been able to reproduce in the studio so please keep sending through your logs for these.
There is an “infinite” card draw bug that may have been fixed and we have not been reproduce this in the studio so please keep sending through the logs. 
If a player goes onto a Dungeon and gets The Stranger and then at the same time encounters any Quest, then Peril scouting will be broken for that player for the rest of the game.

If you encounter any more bugs be sure to let us know over here OR submit an in-game Bug report.

Cheers guys!

<3

Lisy aka yosafbridge

notes.title: v1.1.1 Armellians' (even louder) Roar & Holiday Update!
notes.notes:

Greetings friends!

Firstly, we want to wish you all a very happy holidays! We hope you all kick back and relax, play games and eat a whole bunch of food.

We're excited and a lil festive right now because a cool little update just went live on Steam! This has a few awesome presents and introduces some new background infrastructure, opening doors for sweet, sweet future content.

You may notice a few tweaks such as the News Feed on the main menu, which will keep you up to date with all things Armello!

The full patch notes can be found here.

WARNING: These glorious Dice are absurdly frosty. When rolled, the outcome can be conservatively described as an ice explosion.

Seriously though, whether you're overcoming chilly perils or cutting down enemies with a frigid blade, these are sure to bring on Winter's bite.

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/054/319/808432f52011a5c0f4036a74b0f61cdf_original.png?v=1449710042&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=830488ae344b7e1e79503969accce259

Considering these are a Steam Inventory drop, these dice will also be available for trading between players and on the Steam Marketplace, so an alternative is to find a worthy traveler willing to trade a set.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 3)
notes.notes:
YO!

Our third patch for v1.1 just went live! Thanks for all of your feedback and your reports, it really helps us track down and squash bugs including No-More-Actions (NMA's):

Bug Fixes:
Implemented a patch for Unity which will fix crashes experienced in Ubuntu / Nvidia. 
Fixed an white screen NMA that occurred when loading into a rare case in Multiplayer House Rules initialisation. 
Fixed an NMA when a player passes a Quest and receives a Spirit Stone, if they also then spawn a secret encounter the game would break. 
Fixed an issue which would occur when a public queue would be dismissed by unresponsive/AFK players and the game would then have a miss-matched/incorrect public lobby.
Fixed an NMA when the authority would disconnect from anywhere in-game and the player who is the next to be the authority was also the next turn taker (from the original authority player).
Fixed an NMA where House Rules becomes mismatched across a multiplayer game and the game would fall out of sync. 
Attempting to open/close the Hero Shelf during the King’s Declaration will no longer cause an NMA.
Fixed some wildcard typo’s In the German localisation the Gypsy Caravan quest.
Fixed a typo in the “Rain Dance” quest (English only).
King’s Guards should no longer be spawned on the same tile if they are spawned during the same Dawn phase. For real this time. 
All quests in gendered languages (such as German, French, Spanish) will now use the correct gender for all Heroes, instead of always using female.
Fixed a rare occurrence of a “Warning error” appearing at the final Quest, only in non-English languages but not all (Korean and Spanish were reported).
Single-player games will correctly unpause if a multiplayer queue pops and expires while in the King’s Declaration state.


Known Issues:
If you try and change the graphic quality options in game, they will only take effect once - you cannot change them multiple times in game. (This works fine in the main menu options.)

May your journey for the throne be peril-free.

<3

Darcy and the LoG Team.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 2) [PC/Mac/Linux]
notes.notes:
Hey y’all,

Thanks to those who have continued to submit bug reports and logs to us, you’ve really helped us get this patch together!

So here are the fixes we’ve implemented, keep in mind that NMA means No More Action:


We have figured out a solution to the crashes Armellilans have been experiencing while starting a game. We’ve rolled back the version of Unity we upgraded to for v1.1 which was the primary cause for these NMA’s. 
Fixed NMA caused by Spirit Stone mismatch.
Fixing \ns in TUTORIAL_SPEED_UP_INPUT_INFO.

Known Issues:

If you try and change the graphic quality options in game, they will only take effect once - you cannot change them multiple times in game. (This works fine in the main menu options.)
If you're in a private game lobby (NOT queueing for a public game) and you go play a single player game, House Rules will be reset locally (this can cause the private game to be out of sync). So don't play single player while you're waiting for a​ private​ game.
Don't change House Rules while someone is in the process of joining a private lobby - either do it before you invite them or after they've joined.

Once again, thanks for all your help and let you conquer Armello!

notes.notes:
Hey y’all,

Thanks to those who have continued to submit bug reports and logs to us, you’ve really helped us get this patch together!

So here are the fixes we’ve implemented, keep in mind that NMA means No More Action:


We have figured out a solution to the crashes Armellilans have been experiencing while starting a game. We’ve rolled back the version of Unity we upgraded to for v1.1 which was the primary cause for these NMA’s. 
Fixed NMA caused by Spirit Stone mismatch.
Fixing \ns in TUTORIAL_SPEED_UP_INPUT_INFO.

Known Issues:

If you try and change the graphic quality options in game, they will only take effect once - you cannot change them multiple times in game. (This works fine in the main menu options.)
If you're in a private game lobby (NOT queueing for a public game) and you go play a single player game, House Rules will be reset locally (this can cause the private game to be out of sync). So don't play single player while you're waiting for a​ private​ game.
Don't change House Rules while someone is in the process of joining a private lobby - either do it before you invite them or after they've joined.

Once again, thanks for all your help and let you conquer Armello!

<3

Lisy and the LoG Team

notes.title: Hotfix v1.1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (Patch 1) [PC/Mac/Linux]
notes.notes:
Hey everycorgi!

Through the madness that has been Melbourne International Games Week we’ve been tinkering away on the known issues for v1.1 and solved a quite a few of them, so we thought we’d shoot you all an update as soon as we could. This patch should increase stability in multiplayer games, and allow you to play single player games while queueing for a public match! *the crowd goes wild!*

Without further ado, the changes are as follows (note: NMA stands for No More Action, a state where the game hasn’t crashed, but the flow of gameplay has stopped):

Fixed an issue with playing a single player game while queued for a public multiplayer game, where the public multiplayer game would load into a white screen and be stuck in an NMA state.
Fixed a bug where house rules from custom single player games were persisting across to public queue multiplayer games when you were playing a singleplayer game while in the multiplayer queue.
Attempting to start a single player custom game while in the multiplayer public queue will now proceed correctly.
Fixed a rare case where the Host disconnecting during two other players’ combat could cause the dice to stop rolling and the game to enter an NMA state.
Fixed Darkest Night King’s Declaration NMA.
King’s Guards should no longer be spawned on the same tile if they are spawned during the same Dawn phase.
If you leave a multiplayer party that had custom rules set, the house rules will now clear correctly.

We’ve also found another v1.1 known issue, which is:

If you try and change the graphic quality options in game, they will only take effect once - you cannot change them multiple times in game. (This works fine in the main menu options.)
If you're in a private game lobby (NOT queueing for a public game) and you go play a single player game, House Rules will be reset locally (this can cause the private game to be out of sync). So don't play single player while you're waiting for a​*private*​ game.
Don't change House Rules while someone is in the process of joining a private lobby - either do it before you invite them or after they've joined.

May your claws be sharp; may your wits be sound; we will meet again on Armellian ground.

<3

Lisy

notes.title: Armellians Roar! Armello's first post-release update is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Heyyyy Armellians! 

In case you haven't heard, we're continuing our Early Access style of development and Armello's first major post-release update, Armellians Roar, v1.1 is here!

We had initially stated that Ranked Multiplayer would be coming with v1.1, but considering all of you had a heap of requests and cool ideas for the game, we figured we'd listen and get onto that instead. Also, we figured we'd take the chance to make our multiplayer as secure as possible. 

So here it is, v1.1, Armellians Roar! It's live on Steam right now! PS4 and DRM Free will trail a few weeks behind (as to ensure the most stable experience on those platforms). But what's inside? What are the major beats for the update? Let's check 'em out. 

Pacing Improvements

We've gone through Armello and tweaked the timing on almost every single element in the game to ensure we're giving you the most streamlined and tailored experience. If you feel it's not quite right still, that's totally cool, because we've created more ways for you to control the pacing yourself. 

Turn 'Quick AI Turns' on or off to toggle advanced pacing on AI decisions and movement, or coolest of all, you can hit the "." key to fast-forward your off-turn in single player games. Say whaaaaat?! Yeah, that's right. You heard us. You can now fast-forward AI turns in Single Player. *Mic Drop!*

House Rules

We know you've all been pretty keen on playing around under the hood of Armello's systems, so we've got some exciting new options in Single Player (under a new category called Custom Game) and Private Multiplayer games that we've opened up for you to all have a play around with. 

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/785/046/78a1ef8922e7039dd36849daec7f71bb_original.PNG?v=1446040583&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=5ed2b39640cd8db97de867108b435c95

House Rules will enable you to play around with the King's Health, Heroes' Body, the power of Banes and a bunch of other cool stuff.

New Cards & Amulets

We've added a slew of new items and especially armour(!) to the game, as well as two rad new hero amulets! 

There may even be a very special item that is a nod to some very good friends of ours and their very cool game... bonus points to those that can find it and name the game and studio below. <3

Multiplayer Stability/Security

We've completed redesigned our multiplayer architecture in order to provide a more stable multiplayer experience. Which, excitingly means this is the first step to a reconnect feature. In fact, you may find you reconnect a little bit too. 

In addition to a more stable multiplayer experience, we've been working very closely with Valve to ensure Armello's multiplayer community is as stable as possible. 

Localisation Improvements

We've made major improvements across all languages in order to ensure that Armello's localisation hits that League of Geeks quality that you all know and love. 

Steam Controller Support

I'm sure there's a bunch of you that are all tinkering around with your new Steam Controllers, so we figured we'd support 'em so you can play your way. As the Steam Controller is brand new hardware, this is the first step towards full Steam Controller support. Email us at qa@leagueofgeeks.com with any Steam Controller bugs or feedback. 

Misc. fixes/improvements

All of the above that I just mentioned, that's just the tip of the iceberg. Jump into the full patch notes (which can be found here) if you're keen on seeing all the work we've been getting up to here. 

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/785/070/2b489dbca598cedc5da94fa9fcf04d05_original.png?v=1446040856&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=a9c46b1be34c847e0cf9baca72ca0cab

Development Goes On!

Free, regular, major content updates. That's what I mean when I say this is the way it is. We're going to be doing this for as long as is financially feasible. We loved working with all of you during Early Access, so we're keen to continue that trend and see this game become more incredible than we could have ever imagined. 

That's All Folks

v1.1 is here. What are you doing still reading? Go play! Get your friends together and get going on that quest for the throne! 

<3 LoG

notes.title: Surprise Build Update (v1.0.1) is HERE!
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/UVyG46S.png

Heyo Armellians!
 
It’s been just over two weeks since launch and we wanted to give you a little somethin’ to show you that we’re here to stay and Armello is going to continue to grow and improve.
 
First up, thanks for all the kind words and we’re absolutely thrilled that you’re all loving Armello. However, we’ve also heard you loud and clear on a bunch of different ways that you feel Armello could be improved and we agree across a number of fronts. So, while we’re working on our next major update, v1.1, we thought we’d dump the following into the build.
 
What’s in v1.0.1, you ask? Well, you can check out the patch notes here, but if you want the TL:DR on the juicy bits, read on.
 
Improved Map Visibility When Zoomed Out
 
Bringing the world of Armello to life was always a core goal for us, but in that process it seems we got a little bit overzealous with just how realistic things got when high above Armello. So we’ve made tweaks to a bunch of elements including fog, distance blur and depth of field. We’ve also toned down the size of the clouds.
 
These adjustments should go a long way towards improving map visibility, whilst still retaining the fidelity of Armello as a living breathing world.
 
Check the comparison below:
 
http://i.imgur.com/UgfgkxB.png
 
Selecting AI Heroes
 
Now you can hone your Armello mastery against the Heroes of your choosing. In any game with AI present, once you’ve selected your Hero, Ring and Amulet, you’ll have the option to select the AI Heroes and their load outs.
 
If you can’t be bothered going through and selecting all their kit one by one, but feel like you want a different spread of opponents, we’ve also added a new button ‘Re-roll AI Heroes’ to get a different selection of AI Heroes.
 
http://i.imgur.com/vmKuWJe.gif
 
This new feature is perfect for training against specific hero builds or setting up epic clan wars for you and a friend.
 
More Stability, More Reliability
 
We know that a small number of folks are experiencing drop outs in-game and even a small number is too many, so we’ve gone ahead and improved stability throughout the game and our multiplayer infrastructure.
 
We’ve also killed those few NMAs and crash bugs a few of you have experienced.
 
Also, just a reminder to use the in-game BugSender (accessed via the Pause Menu) to send us a bug report if you’re experiencing any issues with Armello. We investigate every single bug report, but we can’t fix what we don’t know about.  ;)
 
Share the Bandit Clan in Private Games
 
As promised, backers with access to the Bandit Clan can now share them with friends in private multiplayer games. Simply invite your Steam friends to a private multiplayer game to give them access to the Bandit Clan heroes for that game.
 
For those of you that didn’t back at the Bandit Tier, get chummy with some Bandit Backers for a sneak peek at the Bandits before their public release next year.
 
Moving Forward
 
We loved the Early Access style of development and how with all of your assistance, Armello blossomed into the special game it is today. We loved it so much in fact, that we don’t want to stop working like that.
 
So, keep the suggestions and requests coming because major content updates are going to continue rolling in. As you can already see, we’re listening.
 
You can expect us to announce v1.1 and drip feeding details within the next few weeks. 
 
What about DRM Free?
 
For those of you hanging out for the DRM Free build, you’ll be happy to hear that our builds are complete and we’re working with GoG and Humble Bundle to get them ready to go, we’ll announce a release date and get them into your hands asap.
 
Naturally, we’ll put the soundtrack up for a DRM Free release where possible at the same time.
 
Thanks Again!
 
That’s it for v1.0.1. Remember, you can check out the patch notes here.
I just wanted to take the time to say thanks for joining us on this incredible journey and we can’t wait for you to see where it goes from here. We’ve still got a lot planned for Armello and with your assistance, I have no doubt we can make it happen.
 
 
<3 Lisy & the LoG Crew

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/418/658/2616961822773de587f87b15bfc69591_original.png?v=1441105778&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&lossless=true&s=2acfe4e0ca61254b32164278e12f5c36

Hi everyone,

Hope you're enjoying the full release of Armello so far and you're enjoying all the new features we have to offer.

We have a few bugs that we've been able to squish for you! Please keep that feedback rolling as well as your strategy sharing. 


The Toll Bell Sings should now no longer cause NMAs (No More Actions) when King's Guards are killed in multiplayer.
King's Declarations should now always resolve correctly across the network in multiplayer games.
The Early Access badge should now be correctly applied to Early Access players.
Incorrect tags displaying in the buff tooltips on the Hero Shelf are now fixed.
Prologue and "Pride's Edge" card description typos have been fixed.
WASD camera movement controls should now work more reliably.
Particle flickering should be fixed across UI elements.
In Sana's act in the Prologue, the other Heroes should no longer wander through a hidden portal and take out your peril before you get a chance to.
The Hero Select countdown timer has been increased.
You can now select language in Armello's properties within the Steam client (per game, as opposed to per client).
Shadows will now be correctly applied on higher graphics options.
Having the Chat menu open will no longer delay certain game states.


Happy gaming all.

<3

Lisy & the LoG crew.

notes.title: Pride's Fall Hotfix 0.3.5p1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (patch 1)
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/BiyP3Og.png

Hey everyone, hope you’ve been enjoying Pride’s Fall! Have you managed to take out the King yet, with all his new regalia?

We’ve got a few fixes this time - the big ones are mainly related to issues after player-disconnection in multiplayer, or occasions where the game would get stuck in a waiting state in rare circumstances. We’ve also fixed a couple of little visual issues, such as “trial edition” being in the bottom corner of the screen.

As always, if you’re still having any of these issues after you update, or any others, just shoot them through the Bug Report tool in game - those reports are fantastic, and often the logs or reproduction steps contain the vital clues that help us track down rare issues!

Thanks all :D

Here’s the big list o’ fixes (note: NMA refers to "No-More-Action" occurrences, where the game gets stuck and, while it hasn't crashed, gameplay doesn't continue):

Fixed somes NMAs that could occur if a player disconnected in multiplayer while they were questing or in certain combat states.
Fixed an NMA that would occur if a Bane or King’s Guard was in the process of dying as their turn started.
Fixed an NMA that would occur if you collected your fourth Spirit Stone from a Stone Circle while Corrupted, if the Stone Circle had a Peril on it.
Fixed a rare NMA that could occur after the Dawn or Dusk change, or before the Victory screen appeared.
Fixed an issue where Card Draw could overlay with the Victory screen and cause the Accolades button not to function.
Fixed an issue where certain Scout-granting effects (such as Divination) could grant you permanent Scout.
Pausing and resuming the game now stops and starts the music correctly.
Slanderous Toads now correctly removes Prestige and not Gold.
Fixed an issue where the edge of screen camera movement would be too sensitive.
Removed “trial version” from the bottom right corner of the screen.
The Saving Icon is now no longer layered under the Report Bug button.
“Prologue” button is no longer incorrectly highlighted on the Main Menu.
Several new names for Tiles have been added, thanks to community member RedWolf for suggesting them!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.4p2 [PC/Mac/Linux] (patch 2)
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/quBw4eo.png

Hello Armellians! We’ve had a great week thus far, fixing a ton of issues with the game (including some rare ones which have been around for a few builds!) and improving multiplayer stability. A lot of this is due to your help with using the Bug Sender to send in bug reports that have detailed descriptions and repro steps - thank you all so much!

The (rather large) list of issues fixed is as follows (note: NMA here refers to “No-More-Action” occurrences - a state of the game where it hasn’t crashed, but gameplay gets stuck and doesn’t continue):


Fixed the keyboard shortcut for rolling dice to only be active once you are allowed to roll the dice - this was causing combat NMAs.
Fixed an issue where the game would NMA or King’s Declaration cards would get stuck on the screen if a player disconnected during the King’s Declaration process.
Fixed an NMA which could occur if a King’s Guard had the “Spy Network” card played on them and then died.
Fixed an NMA that would occur in a multiplayer game when a remote player played a card such as “Wandering Circus”, “Glamour”, “Cat Burglar” or “Dark Influence” while a player was completing the process of drawing cards at the start of their turn.
Fixed rare NMA relating to creatures dying during the King’s Declaration “The Toll Bell Sings”.
Improved the “Select Quest” button display logic, and fixed an NMA that would occur if you closed the “Select Quest” panel just before your turn began.
Fixed a bug where the Infected and Corrupted statuses would not properly update in a loaded Singleplayer game - they would only update to match your Rot value after you moved or the day/night phase started.
Mercurio killing the King through the Ruby Ring will no longer award him a Combat Victory even though he has died.
Fixed a bug where, if a player disconnected in multiplayer, the AI player that took them over would gain an ability where their AP would be refilled after they died on their turn, and they could just continue on from their clan grounds. Zombie AI Thane is no more!
The “Sailor’s Lantern” item will now correctly reset upon player death.
The AI will no longer kill themselves with the “Aflame” card.
Fixed an issue where the “Haste” spell would not give you an extra action point for your next turn if you played it to yourself when it wasn’t your turn.
Fixed an issue where the “Blacksmith” follower would not appear from Dungeons or in Quests.
Fixed an issue where the “Trader” follower effect would continue to be applied even if the card was unequipped.
Fixed an issue where if you saved and loaded the game in a state where a Hero loaded a settlement, then saved and loaded a second time when that settlement was terrorised, on the third load the Settlement would be both captured by a Hero and terrorised.
The Hero Shelf character tooltips should now always display the correct text.
AI will no longer play the card “Vile Official” on themselves.
Fixed the “Emissary” card’s playback speed.
Fixed typo in the Hanging Judge Quest rumour text.
Simplified Hot Rot Wine effect text.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.3p1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (patch 1)
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/GTqNzjZ.png

Hey everyone!

At Wyld's Will was a massive update and, just like my great grandmother always said, after a massive update comes a massive patch, to fix all the bugs - er, I mean, to improve all the features that we added!

Some of these issues were common and others were rare, but all of them were found with the help of you, the community. Thank you for your help, and remember to keep using that Report Bug Button whenever you find a bug!

(Note: NMA here means “No-More-Action”, and refers to when the game gets into a state where it get stuck and no longer continues the gameplay sequence.)

WARNING: Due to an issue with the save sessions in the initial release, updating to this hotfix will clear any current game of Armello you have saved. If you've got a sweet game of Armello going, hold off on the update until you finish it! (Just to confirm, you won't lose any Ring/Amulet progress - just the current session of Armello that you have saved, if you have one.)


 Fixed some issues where Heroes or Creatures could be attacked while receiving damage or dying, which could cause NMAs.
 Fixed some timing issues where NMAs could arise from Card play and Combat occurring at the same time (eg. attacking a Hero that is just about to play the “Teleport” Card).
 Fixed NMA that could occur when both the King and his attacker die in combat, and the attacker was the only Hero in the palace.
 Fixed a King’s Declaration NMA that would occur in “overtime” in multiplayer games, after one of the King’s Declarations “Dark Army” or “Dark Liege” were selected.
 Fixed issue where a saved game session wouldn’t load up if one of the Heroes in the saved game had a War Horn equipped.
 Fixed an NMA where, if a Hero Banished themselves while on a Dungeon and all other Dungeons were occupied, they would attempt to attack themselves.
 Fixed an NMA that could occur after stealthed characters were killed off-turn.
 Fixed an NMA that could occur after an AI Player was waiting for a Bane or King’s Guard to die.
 Spirit Stones that Crystallise on top of King’s Guards will now correctly be destroyed by that King’s Guard.
 Added a prompt to warn when starting a new Singleplayer game that if you have a saved session it will be overwritten.
 Fixed Body Icon to correctly display when viewing a Body Quest in the Journal.
 Typo fixes!

 Fixed "Blood Moon" King's Declaration description typo.
 Fixed "Fog of War" King's Declaration description typo.
 Fixed “The Deep Dig” Rabbit Clan Quest outcome typo.
 Fixed “The God in the Grass” Bear Clan Quest outcome typo.
 Fixed “The Last of Dawn’s Call” Bear Clan Quest name typo.
 Fixed several Status Feed typos.
 Fixed “War Hammer” Card flavour text typo.
 Fixed Trickery Deck tooltip typo.
 Fixed Rabbit Clan Signet typo.
 Fixed “Explore” tutorial typos.
 Fixed “Playing Perils” tutorial typo.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.2p2 [PC/Mac/Linux] (patch 2)
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

So it's been a little while since the last patch, but with your help we've managed to track down a few more issues and NMAs (No-More-Actions), and are releasing a new patch today! Here are the fixes:

 Fixed NMAs related to selecting third and fourth tier Wolf Clan Quests if you were already Corrupted.
 Some other Rumour selection issues have been resolved.
 Selecting a Quest just as your turn starts, or just as you are attacked, will no longer cause an NMA.
 Burning a card right as a Combat ends will no longer cause an NMA.
 Setting up a replacement King's Guard should no longer cause intermittent NMAs as Day starts.
 Using a card to kill a character just before their turn starts will no longer cause an NMA.
 Using a card to move a character or spawn a Bane as a player's turn starts should no longer cause NMAs.
 The screen should no longer stay blurry in certain cases after the Rumour selection screen is active.
 You should no longer get invalid "Incompatible Version" popups when trying to Queue - if you do get an "Incompatible Version" popup, make sure you update to the latest version through Steam!
 Leaving a Queue while in a Singleplayer game will no longer end the Singleplayer game.
 Fixed a typo in the King's Declaration: "Healthcare".

Those are quite a few fixes! Hopefully your games - particularly multiplayer games - will be more stable from now on. Have fun Armellians, and remember to use the Bug Sender whenever you run into a bug!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.2p1 [PC/Mac/Linux] (patch 1)
notes.notes:
Hey Armellians! A hotfix is now live that resolves some critical issues with the latest release (0.3.2 - Engines of Fate). We've fixed quite a few issues, such as:

The Dice should no longer get stuck in Combat and cause NMAs (No-More-Actions). 
Fixed an issue where Durations of effects (such as Mirror Image) were persisting after the Deck was reshuffled and that Card was drawn again. 
 Fixed the End Turn button not being click-able after playing Welcoming Party on yourself on your turn. 
Fixed an issue where the "Start of the [x] Day" title would sometimes stick around for the whole round. 
Fixed an issue where, if one of the combatants of a Combat died due to the Bane Blade, they would still attempt to finish the movement (this caused issues such as incorrect teleportation over the network). 
You will now be notified in the Buff Bar that you are Poisoned after you fail a Plague Peril. 
Your Steam username will now be displayed in singleplayer as your player name. 
The Status Feed will no longer block progression to the Accolades screen if it is fully opened when the game ends. 
The Signets and Amulets that you've unlocked will now display more correctly. 
The Card "Incite Revolt" now correctly says that the Settlement will become Terrorised (as opposed to just "unclaimed"). 

And for our finale:
When you Banish yourself onto a Dungeon, which THEN spawns a Bane, which THEN pushes to onto a tile that your Quest happens to be on, the game will no longer get stuck in a state where the Quest resolution screen and Bane Combat are both overlaid onto each other.

Phew!

Thanks for playing everyone, and remember to use that Bug Sender whenever you run into a bug!

notes.title: Major Build Update: Engines of Fate (v0.3.2) has ARRIVED!
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/lqbOmxH.png 

Hey y’all, 

It’s here! Our second Early Access build, Engines of Fate is now ready for all you Armellian’s to play. You may have already seen just a few of the juicy features we have for you in our latest updates, if you haven’t.. SURPRISE!

One feature that we’ve seen some of the community asking for was the ability to see into other heroes combat and peril rolls, well now you can! As well as this, if some other pesky hero attacks the King all players will be shown this combat. 

We’ve done a huge overhaul to our Quest system complete with new artwork and animations. This new system will give you the ability to boost stats on your heroes to help carve your path to victory. 

Features/Changes

Cards
We’re excited to add 11 new cards including 9 Trickery. This means that almost ALL of the Trickery cards are in the game:
Pick Pockets (Trickery): (Play on) Settlement; Steal 1 Gold or else 1 Equipped Item.
Beheaded (Trickery): (Play on) Settlement; -1 Recruited Follower (randomly selected).
Bribery (Trickery): (Play on) Hero; Steal 1 Recruited Follower to your Hand.
Welcoming Party (Trickery): (Play on) Settlement; Teleport target to the nearest free Mountain Hex.
Emissary (Trickery): (Play on) Settlement; Claim target Settlement to your Clan (Instant).
Hoodwinked (Trickery):  (Play on) Settlement, Dungeon; Unequip All Items back to Hero's Hand.
Saboteur (Trickery):  (Play on) Hero; Heroes Dice will not Explode until the end of their next Turn.
Expendables (Trickery): (Play on) Peril; Clears 1 level of Peril Resist which may Clear away the Peril (Instant).
Merchant’s Agreement (Trickery): (Play on) Hero (Not Self); Both Players +1 Gold per Turn until one player Dies.
Winged Boots (Item): Ignore Mountain and Swamp Tile Penalties.
Coin Master (Follower): Convert unused AP at the end of your turn into Gold.
Plus numerous improvements to existing cards.

Quest System
We have given the Quest system a complete overhaul. Features within this system include:
During your off-turn you will be able select from three rumours of happenings around Armello which are your Quest options.
Every Quest will give you a Stat boost and 1 Prestige.
Once you reach your Quest you will be given two options; one that will test your Stat in return for a chance to receive a Treasure, Follower or Spirit Stone. The other will be a no risk Stat and Prestige boost. 
Once you have completed four Quests, you will unlock a Palace Peril tile for you to storm the Palace (if you choose).

Life Support.
Dark Army.

Thanks folks!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.1p1 (patch 1)
notes.notes:
Hey all! We've just released a hotfix patch today that resolves a few critical issues with the latest release (0.3.1) - it fixes some rare issues that would cause NMAs (No More Actions) in single and multiplayer games in the late-game (after some heroes had attempted Palace Perils and failed), as well as improving our support for certain AMD processors with regards to our min-spec registration.

We've been getting several bug reports through from players with multiple graphics cards on their machine (ie. laptops with a gaming graphics card and an integrated graphics card for use on power-saving mode), where they're expecting the game to automatically use the dedicated card but their machine is actually using the integrated graphics card.

Unfortunately we're not able to detect that you have multiple graphics cards and get Armello to use the one you want it to use - it's up to you to activate the graphics card you want to use on your computer. For most graphics cards, you can do this in the vendor's control panel - visit your graphics card vendor's website to learn more.

Thanks for playing everyone! I know I'm personally having a blast with the Rot changes in this update (not to mention those new King's Declarations). The only issue now is that my Sana wins every game. Oh well.

And here's your TL;DR - these issues should now be fixed:
- Players getting stuck when taking their turns after attempting Palace Perils. (NMA) 
- Min spec incorrectly being applied to some AMD processors.
- Leaving a queue while playing a single player game quitting that game.
- Multiplayer breaking when players are auto-assigned characters.

notes.title: First Major (HUGE) Update v0.3.1 is Now Live!
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/ZUEu3dF.jpg 

Hey y’all,

Our first major Early Access update has arrived! We’ve been teasing out a few of the features included in this build, but there’s much more to discover in-game.

The feature at the top of our list was also the most requested, so as of this build, if a player leaves a game prematurely AI will take over and the game will continue!

The Bounty system is one of the biggest features we’ve implemented in this release - it adds a whole new dynamic to the game. Bunch of supporting cards and a lot more ways to backstab! 

Also, you can now play certain cards to King’s Guards and Banes! Game changer! 

Couple of things to point out:

If you have custom keybinds please check them after each new release as updating keybinds will wipe any custom mappings. 
Depending on your firewall, you may need to re-add Armello as an exception to your Firewall log.


Features/Changes
Cards

Cleansing Wyld (Spell), Plague (Spell) and Banish (Spell) 
Heroes can now play certain cards to King’s Guards and Bane’s. 
Poison has now been separated out as its own special effect (similar to Infected and Corrupted effects)
To support both the Bounty system and also inject some more Rot in the world, we have unleashed 13 new cards:
False Orders (Trickery): (Play on) King's Guard; Force King's Guard to an adjacent hex
Cubs Blood (Item): (Play on) Tile Any; Lure nearest Bane to this Tile
Rite of Wyld (Spell): (Play on) Stone Circle, Dungeon, Plains, Bane’s; -1 Health for every Rot point target has
Reprieve (Trickery): (Play on) Hero; Target is cleared of any Bounty
Bounty (Trickery): (Play on) Hero; Target receives a Bounty on their Head
Bane Blade (Treasure): In Battle, +3 Dice and after the Battle -1 Health
Plague Bearers (Trickery): (Play on) Swamps, Dungeons; -2 Health and if target dies this turn they gain +1 Rot
Dark Influence (Spell): (Play on) Hero, Dungeon; Target gains +1 Rot and a Plague Spell card in their Hand
Crime Lord (Trickery): (Play on) Self; Steal 1 Gold from Every other Player
Royal Pardon (Item): A King's Bounty cannot be issued against you!
Malice Rising (Spell): (Play on) Any Empty Hex; Sumon Bane here
Call of the Worm (Spell): (Play on) Hero; All the Cards in the Target's Hand change to the Rot Symbol - Animal suggested by dragoncrescent!
Bane’s Claw (Item): Bane’s will never Attack you!

Bounty System
Players can now have a Bounty of 3 Gold and 1 Prestige placed on their head for the following:
Attacking a King’s Guard
Playing negative cards onto King’s Guards
Entering the Palace
Having ‘Bounty’ played onto you. 
Certain King’s Declarations.
When you have a Bounty on your head both King’s Guards and enemy Heroes will want your head.
If an enemy Hero kills you in Battle, they will claim your Bounty and gain 3 Gold and 1 additional Prestige!
If you die through any other means, your Bounty will be cleared.
As above, there are new cards in the game to support this system including Bounty. (Trickery), Reprieve (Trickery) and Royal Pardon (Treasure).

Artificial Intelligence
Our AI friends have been given some extra training:
AI now have a better chance of passing Palace Perils as well as knowing to go for the Palace if a Peril has been previously cleared. In the past the AI didn’t burn cards or have a real strategy for passing Palace Perils.
AI will now roll their dice once a Human player has.
AI now know how to react to Swamps when on low health.
AI now know how to react to having Poisoned Gift played on them.
The issue with AI’s continuously Double Dungeon Dipping have been removed.
The issue with AI’s attacking King’s Guards a lot have been tweaked.


King’s Declarations

One new King’s Declaration has been added to every tier, meaning that each game will present different options for King’s Decs. New King’s Declarations.
Additionally, we have amended and adjusted some King’s Declarations.


Multiplayer

On Hero Select the “Back” button has been changed to “Leave Game” to avoid accidentally leaving the game.
In Public Multiplayer: Clicking on the Hero Portrait a second time will unselect that Hero. 
In Multiplayer the first turn taker is now randomised (it used to be whoever created the lobby or first to queue)
Players who abandon a Public Multiplayer game will not be able to re-queue for a game for 60 seconds. This doesn't affect Private games

Visuals

After numerous bug reports, the Explore icon for “Nothing” has been updated to look more like… nothing? ;)
Brand new Intro sequence when loading the game, including new splash screens and trailer. 
Camera Engaged and Unengaged Icons have been updated.
Hero Select Screen changes: You’ll see some friendly new faces to preview what will be coming at the full release of Armello.


Miscellaneous 
Dawn Summary Panel changes:
You can now view the Dawn Summary Panel during gameplay by pressing and holding “TAB”
Black sprite added behind the Dawn Summary to make it clearer.
Options Menu Updates:
There is now an option to select or unselect the Hardware Mouse
Keybind for Rolling Dice in-game has been set to “R”
Tooltips!
When a card is in Focus mode, words that are underlined can now be hovered over for a tooltip on that ability/effect/state.
All tiles in Armello now have Tooltips explain the type, effect or modifier and the name of the tile. Each tile has its own unique name, try and find them all! - Thanks to Hobbes for helping Trent name some at 2:30am. lol
Hero Power changes:
Sana: After much discussion, we changed Sana’s hero power as it was just a little too complicated and making her a tad too difficult to play. Now, when in combat with any corrupted Creature, Sana uses her Spirit as her fight. 
End Game Screen changes:
You can now access the Hero and Inventory shelf from the Victory screen.
General clean up of particles. 
Combat Screen changes:
The Combat Wipe (screen effect when entering combat) has been sped up. 
Improved communication of Rot Battles: if both Creatures in Battle have Rot, there is now a sequence which shows which Creature has the most Rot and thus, receives the Rot bonus. More improvements to this coming. 
The word “Attack” has been moved to the bottom of the Attack panel for better visibility. 
Status Feed changes:
Hovering over a King’s Declaration in the feed will now display the card for the Declaration.
The Status Feed now has tooltips for Perils encountered. Hovering over the word ‘Peril’ will show that card.  
You can now only scroll through the Status Feed history when the feed has been opened.
You should see an overall improvement in game performance as we’ve done many passes of optimisation across the whole game.
Overhauled Animation events system to utilise Unity 5’s new state based animation system. 
All burn down timers have been increased by five (5) seconds.
The in-game Bug Sender tool has had a facelift. Now you can “tag” your bug to be a “Bug”, “Typo” or “Design” issue!


Full build notes, including Bug Fixes and Known Issues over at the LoG forums!

Thanks folks! 


<3 Trent & the LoG Crew

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.0p2 (patch 2)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We've just set a new build live (0.3.0p2) which has some fixes for issues to do with AI players occasionally not taking their turn and being able to click through the game guide.

We've also attempted to improve some rare issues where sound would be crackly, or the camera would always move to the edge of the board. If you're still getting these issues after updating, please use the bug sender and let us know!

Finally, we're getting quite a few bugs through from people who are running on lower than our minimum specifications (you can see these on our steam page - make sure you're looking at the specs for your platform). We're currently still letting the game run on machines below min specs, but we can't guarantee that it'll work - you run the game on these machines at your own risk!

Thanks for playing everyone! Now to get back to working on the next update... we're cooking up some pretty exciting stuff, can't wait to let you play it :D

TL;DR, here are the things that should now be fixed:
- AI players getting stuck when taking their turns. (NMA)
- Clicking through the Game Guide.
- Crackly audio.
- Camera stuck moving toward the edge of the board.
